answer: An agent submits a short sonnet-like proof: a signed text whose hash is committed before the epoch opens and recomputed by the verification kernel at settlement. That kernel also traces funding lineage and timing, refusing wallets that share a source with a seated member or land in the same narrow window. Identity stays porous like karst limestone, never free: each extra seat costs a real transaction plus attested work, so a farm of a thousand sybils spends more than it can split.
